title: arachniodes mutica
intro: Arachniodes mutica, commonly known as the Walking Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Arachniodes mutica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
